text:
ana: quick thought — proposal to relax embeddings endpoint so clients can send mixed-dim arrays if they opt in via header. router would split into uniform sub-batches and route per-model. avoids a lot of 413 churn for multi-model clients.

sam: how do we bill/charge for splits? we'd need predictable quota semantics or we'll get support tickets.

ana: plan: bill per original item using the target model's unit price. for splitter-generated child requests we emit telemetry linking child -> parent ID so usage and billing are reconciled server-side. clients still see single response.

jordan: worry: splitting adds overhead and hurts batching efficiency. our load tests for runtime splitter showed ~3% 95p token latency increase on p3-like nodes.

meera: console/telemetry needs: show split_rate, avg_splits_per_request, and per-split latency histogram. also surface percentage of requests that had partial failures. we should add a column in per-route table: "split enabled".

ana: implementation notes:
```
Header: X-Embeddings-Allow-Split: true
Payload: { "inputs": [[...],[...]], "model": "embed-large" }
Router: if mixed dims -> create child reqs grouped by dims -> forward
Response: 200 + { "results": [...], "split_info": { "children": 3, "partial_failures": [] } }
```

sam: partial failures — do we return 207 Multi-Status or always 200 with per-item status? returning 207 breaks a lot of SDKs.

meera: prefer 200 with per-item status array. then console can show failure rate. SDKs parse it as normal.

jordan: canary suggestion: feature flag default-off for hosted; enable for dedicated customers by config first. tag telemetry: split_feature=canary-<id>. rollout only after we have split-aware batching in runtime.

infra-bot: load-test comment: "splitter + per-child routing" increased CPU on router by 8% and added 0.5ms to median request path in our 50k req/s test. (perf-run id: perf/2026-03-12/43)

sam: need billing docs change: if child fails we still charge for successful children. if parent-level timeout occurs before children finish we prorate recorded tokens. I'll draft language.

meera: UX: add a small indicator on route details: "split enabled (canary)" and a histogram for split_count; add alert if split_rate > 10% and 95p latency regresses > 2x compared to baseline.

jordan: I'll prototype router split + telemetry events this week. can follow this cf-branch: feature/embed-splitter. I'll post PR with perf numbers.

ana: action items: jordan prototype, meera console metrics + alert rules, sam billing blurb, i'll write RFC and include traffic model + SLO targets. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: thanks. can we also log a sample of original payloads that trigger split for 24h for debugging? redaction required.

ana: yes — sample at 0.1% with PII redaction. will include in RFC.

meera: ok, i'm adding telemetry fields: ["parent_request_id","child_request_ids","split_count","split_reason","split_enabled_flag"], will send schema.

jordan: noted. I'll tag all child requests with parent_request_id and split_version.

ana: cool. I'll open the RFC tomorrow and cc infra/product. end.
